candidate.answerReason: OP is explicitly stated to bisect the 70° angle, so angle AOP measures 70° divided by 2, or 35°.

methods.label: Use the stated angle bisector
methods.explanation: Since \(OP\) is the stated bisector of \(\angle AOB\), it divides the angle into two equal parts. Therefore \(\angle AOP=70^\circ\div2=35^\circ\).
methods.levelReason: The angle-bisector definition and elementary halving are sufficient and lie within Grade 8 prerequisites.
